items.html: And two aspects of Gevura were found in her. The first: what she received from Ima at the time of the sawing, which were strong Gevurot and harsh judgments. And the second: what she received from ZA after he awakened from his sleep by means of the Shofar blast, which are Gevurot more sweetened and mitigated. Also it is found that what was sawed from him on the first day of Rosh HaShanah is from the Keter until the completion of his Tifferet; and what was sawed from her is her Keter alone.
